Nothing matches that search.

<div style="text-align:center; margin-top:1rem;">

</div>

<script>
function bcFilterMedia() {
  var query = document.getElementById("media-search").value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll(".media-card");
  var visibleCount = 0;
  cards.forEach(function(card) {
    var match = card.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1;
    card.style.display = match ? "" : "none";
    if (match) visibleCount++;
  });
  var noResults = document.getElementById("media-no-results");
  if (noResults) {
    noResults.style.display = (cards.length > 0 && visibleCount === 0) ? "block" : "none";
  }
}
</script>
